BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No 8-I in an area bounded by:

South Archer Avenue; a line 124 feet southeast of and parallel to South Campbell Avenue as
measured along the South right-of-way line of South Archer Avenue and perpendicular
thereto; the alley next south of and parallel to South Archer Avenue; and a line 76 feet
southeast of and parallel to South Campbell Avenue as Measured along the south right of
way line of South Archer Avenue and perpendicular thereto,

to those of a C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.

Common Address of Property: 3787-89 South Archer Avenue
